reason: A browser plugin for the DSH web UI focused on conversation navigation and readability enhancements, with an additional session cost display based on observed API usage data.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供按轮次导航、思维链自动展开和会话成本显示功能。
summaries.en: Enhances the DSH web interface with turn-by-turn navigation, automatic reasoning expansion, and session cost display.

capabilities: Reads conversation structure and rendered session content
Adds navigation controls and scroll behavior to the web interface
Expands reasoning disclosures through DOM interaction
Reads provider, model, token usage, and request timing data
Persists session cost tracking and preferences in localStorage
